_comment: Calibrated for videoplayback.mp4 (298x640 portrait phone capture). All values are fractions of frame width/height: [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Re-run tools/inspect_frame.py and tools/calibrate.py for a different recording.
_slots_comment: The four cards in hand, left to right. Excludes the 'Next:' card and the elixir bar.
_bars_comment: The enemy princess tower health bars, tight to the coloured strip. Fitted against four hand-read health values; the implied max health came out within 0.3% on both towers.
_colour_comment: HSV bounds for the enemy bar red. OpenCV hue is 0-179 so red needs two ranges, one at each end.
